changeSet.author: jens@ist-ur.org
changeSet.comment: Create Aufenthaltstitel categories for any residence-status value not already in the list
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO categories (id, name, type, created_at, to_be_deleted) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), v.name, 'Aufenthaltstitel', now(), false FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT trim(current_resident_status) AS name FROM clients WHERE current_resident_status IS NOT NULL AND trim(current_resident_status) <> '' ) v WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.type = 'Aufenthaltstitel' AND c.name = v.name );

changeSet.author: jens@ist-ur.org
changeSet.comment: Link each client's residence status to every case of that client
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO join_category (category_id, entity_id, category_type, entity_type, created_at) SELECT cat.id, ca.id, 'Aufenthaltstitel', 'CASE', now() FROM clients cl JOIN cases ca ON ca.client_id = cl.id JOIN categories cat ON cat.type = 'Aufenthaltstitel' AND cat.name = trim(cl.current_resident_status) WHERE cl.current_resident_status IS NOT NULL AND trim(cl.current_resident_status) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM join_category jc WHERE jc.entity_id = ca.id AND jc.entity_type = 'CASE' AND jc.category_type = 'Aufenthaltstitel' );

changeSet.author: jens@ist-ur.org
changeSet.comment: Aufenthaltstitel is a single-select. The table's own unique constraint is on (category_id, entity_id, category_type, entity_type) and therefore permits several different titles on one case; this partial index enforces at most one.
